name: inprocess-obi-apb-pulp-i2c-level-stuck-f5
notes: PULP apb_i2c real level interrupt: CTRL=0xc0 (core_en|ien), TX=0x5a, CMD=0x10 (write); STATUS[0] is the cause and CMD[0]=1 is the iack clear. SCL/SDA are held high, so the transfer completes with a NACK and still raises s_done.
The F5 handler reads STATUS (0xc) then writes CMD (0x14)=1; a level still high after the handler is reported as level_stuck and the device is reset before the next case.
Negative control: declared clear CMD=0x10 does not write iack, so the level remains high after the handler; expect level_stuck 1, device_resets 1, and the following F2 clean.
